methodology: GitHub job/step durations have1s resolution; full runner duration is authoritative and may exceed sum of step durations.
Dispatcher monotonic timers have finer resolution and are nested inside test steps. They are not added to job duration.
Dependency restore3.5s reported in c1 logs is inside the coarse3s Action step; it is not an extra cost to add.
Comparisons use separate runners and are observational, not isolated causal measurements. Public runner charge is0; rounded minutes are modeled.
